_about: Lombardi Memorial Center (decisions/0023, updated): the back of the athletics complex, joined to McShane and the gym. Two big cream boxes (fieldhouse with the indoor track, and the pool), white barrel vaults behind McShane, and its glass entrance where it pokes out east of the gym.
